title: DS3 EV Transitions Project
description: A public-facing dashboard for the UCSD Center for Energy Research analyzing how EV adoption affects oil dependency across 50+ countries from 2010–2035, built with IEA energy data.

title: Power Outage Duration Prediction
description: An end-to-end machine learning pipeline that predicts power outage duration from 1,500+ U.S. outage events, using a tuned Random Forest regressor and permutation feature importance.
